recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結：下方有具生發中心的反應性次級濾泡，中上方大片淡粉紅色、互相連通的組織球區域把深藍色淋巴球分隔成條索狀，淋巴結架構仍保留，呈良性組織球增生（竇組織球增生／副皮質擴張）的圖像。
features: Lymph node with preserved overall architecture and capsule at lower left
Reactive secondary follicle with germinal center and mantle zone at the bottom
Extensive pale eosinophilic zones of histiocytes forming interconnected, serpiginous bands that expand the paracortex/sinus areas
Dark lymphocyte-rich cords compartmentalized between the pale histiocytic areas
No sheets of atypical cells, necrosis or granulomas at this low power
describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node shows preserved architecture with a reactive secondary follicle containing a germinal center at the bottom of the field. The paracortex and sinus regions are extensively expanded by pale eosinophilic aggregates of histiocytes forming interconnected, serpiginous bands that separate cords of small dark lymphocytes. No necrosis, granulomas or sheets of cytologically atypical cells are seen at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a reactive histiocytic proliferation with sinus histiocytosis and paracortical expansion; in the same node, melanin-laden histiocytes at high power support dermatopathic change.

ddx.vs: Dermatopathic change produces pale paracortical nodules of Langerhans and interdigitating dendritic cells with melanin-laden macrophages, which requires high power (and S100/CD1a) to confirm.
Rosai-Dorfman shows markedly dilated sinuses filled with large S100-positive histiocytes displaying emperipolesis, often with capsular fibrosis and plasma cells.
Metastatic cells are cohesive with nuclear atypia and keratin positivity, whereas sinus histiocytes are bland and CD68/CD163-positive.
LCH distends sinuses with Langerhans cells having grooved nuclei and abundant eosinophils and is CD1a/langerin-positive.
